title: Acceptance clauses
statement: For a Boolean-symbol Turing machine $M$ and natural numbers $n,s$, let $a(n)$ denote the state variable offset and let $b_M(n,s,0)$ denote the summary variable associated with the false value. The acceptance formula is the conjunction of the two unit clauses requiring both variables to be true.
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the state and summary variable offsets, so their precise meanings cannot be specified here.
